correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs all equilibria for \(a,b,c>0\) and shows forward completeness from the exact derivative \(\dot H=-(z-b)^2+(c-b)(z-b)\). For \(c>b\) a positive proper quadratic has derivative \(-ax^2-b(z-c)^2/(c-b)\); the only invariant zero-derivative state is E_c, with a Hurwitz linearization. For \(c=b\) the compact full omega-limit argument excludes all states except E_b, and for \(c<b\) two additional equilibria and a positive eigenvalue preclude global attraction. A symbolic polynomial calculation verifies center manifold \(x=(b/a)u+Bu^3\), \(z-b=(b/a)u^2+Du^4\) and reduced \(\dot u=-(b/a)^2u^3-\ell u^5+O(u^7)\). The exact coefficient ell/k yields the logarithmic correction; integrability of the residual proves finite additive C, and exponential foliation tracking transports it to all nonexceptional physical trajectories. A locally two-dimensional strong-stable manifold and countable inverse images establish the measure-zero exception. Symbolic and numerical executable checks passed; finite tests do not stand in for proofs.
